notes.title: Metal Brigade Tactics being removed from sale.
notes.content: [p]Metal Brigade Tactics is being removed from sale at the end of August. If you already own the game, it will remain in your library, but it will no longer be available for purchase.[/p][p][/p][p]We thank all the pilots that have joined us in our turn-based giant robot battles![/p]

notes.title: Metal Brigade Tactics Available Now!
notes.content: Metal Brigade Tactics is now available on Steam!

notes.title: Metal Brigade Tactics is coming to Steam!
notes.content: The original PC version of the classic turn based strategy game is finally coming to Steam on August 27th!
